cityQuote: I was born in Belfast between the mountain and the gantries / To the hooting of lost sirens and the clang of trams

quoteAlternatives.quote: The hard cold fire of the northerner / Frozen into his blood from the fire in his basalt / Glares from behind the mica of his eyes
quoteAlternatives.note: Harsher in tone; the poem goes on to criticise the city. Text from memory; source page appeared in search but its text was not seen.

quoteAlternatives.quote: My name? Where am I coming from? Where am I going? A fusillade of question-marks.
quoteAlternatives.attribution: Ciaran Carson, poet, from Belfast Confetti (1987)
quoteAlternatives.note: About a riot during the Troubles; strong but narrow. Text from memory, not seen in snippet.
